name: Annas Garten
beschreibung: The hotel Annas Garten is situated in an idyllic rural community in Tyrol. The rooms are furnished with indigenous wood and feature either a private balcony or terrace. The breakfast offering focuses on regional ingredients and fresh produce grown in the hotel's own garden. A sauna area is provided for guests to unwind. From the property, varied hiking trails and mountain bike routes are directly accessible. In winter, cross-country skiing tracks pass conveniently close to the building. This accommodation is tailor-made for travellers seeking a restorative stay surrounded by nature.
